recommendation_summary: The reply says to keep cron on edna and add one hosted dead-man's-switch monitor: the job sends it a heartbeat after the sync finishes, and the monitor emails the user if that heartbeat misses the deadline plus a grace period.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central log storage and a Docker migration; neither provides the missing alert by itself.
labels.Bottleneck: The job sends email only if it reaches the email step, so startup failures stay silent.
labels.Checked myself: No independent checks in this exercise. You reported four missed runs, no other alerts, and an available Synology.

note: All four labelled lines come before the recommendation, it recommends exactly one alert, and it rejects the central-log and Docker setup outright.
